user.title: Connect to Meitheal
user.description: Enter the address of your Meitheal server and a scoped Meitheal API token.

data_description.host: The server hostname or IP address. Enter only the hostname or address.
data_description.port: The port where Meitheal is reachable. A Supervisor App uses port 3000.
data_description.ssl: Turn this on for a manual connection. The internal network of an installed Supervisor App uses HTTP.
data_description.api_token: Create a dedicated Meitheal agent token in the Meitheal settings with task and search permissions.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect to the Meitheal App
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant found the Meitheal App at {host}:{port}. Enter a scoped Meitheal API token.

data_description.api_token: Create a dedicated Meitheal agent token in the Meitheal settings with task and search permissions.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Meitheal
reconfigure.description: Update the address or add a new Meitheal API token. Leave the token field blank to keep the existing credential at the same address.

data_description.host: The server hostname or IP address. Enter only the hostname or address.
data_description.port: The port where Meitheal is reachable. A Supervisor App uses port 3000.
data_description.ssl: Turn this on for a manual connection. The internal network of an installed Supervisor App uses HTTP.
data_description.api_token: Create a dedicated Meitheal agent token in the Meitheal settings with task and search permissions.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Meitheal
reauth_confirm.description: Meitheal denied access to tasks. Create a Meitheal API token with task permissions and enter it below. Use Reconfigure if you also need to change the address.

data_description.api_token: Create a dedicated Meitheal agent token in the Meitheal settings with task and search permissions.

abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant received an invalid App address.
abort.configuration_changed: The connection settings changed. Open the form again to use the current settings.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read tasks from Meitheal. Check the App, address and TLS certificate.
error.invalid_auth: Enter a valid Meitheal API token with permission to read tasks.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address and a port from 1 to 65535.
error.insecure_connection: Use HTTPS or verify this address is the installed Meitheal App on port 3000 in Supervisor.
error.token_required_for_origin: Enter a token issued by the Meitheal instance at this address.

create_task.name: Create Task
create_task.description: Create a new task in Meitheal.

title.name: Title
title.description: The title of the task to create

description.name: Description
description.description: Optional description or notes for the task

assigned_to.name: Assignee ID
assigned_to.description: User ID or agent assignee ID to assign the task to

assignee_user.name: Assignee User
assignee_user.description: Alternative name or ID for the assigned user

complete_task.name: Complete Task
complete_task.description: Mark a task as done by ID or title.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task ID to complete (use either this or title)

title.name: Title
title.description: Find and complete a task by title (use either this or task_id)

sync_todo.name: Sync Tasks
sync_todo.description: Trigger a manual refresh of task data from Meitheal.

search_tasks.name: Search Tasks
search_tasks.description: Search tasks by keyword. Returns matching tasks from Meitheal.

query.name: Search Query
query.description: Keyword to search in task titles and descriptions

status.name: Status Filter
status.description: Filter by task status (backlog, todo, in_progress, or done)

get_overdue_tasks.name: Get Overdue Tasks
get_overdue_tasks.description: Get a list of all tasks that are past their due date and not yet completed.

notify_overdue.name: Notify Overdue
notify_overdue.description: Push a notification about overdue tasks to HA persistent notifications.

complete_task_by_tag.name: Complete Task by NFC Tag
complete_task_by_tag.description: Complete the unique task assigned to this NFC tag.

tag_id.name: Tag ID
tag_id.description: The NFC tag ID assigned through the task API

task_not_found.message: Task not found. Make sure the task ID or title is correct.

addon_unavailable.message: Cannot reach the Meitheal addon. Make sure it is running.

nfc_complete_failed.message: Failed to complete task by NFC tag: {error}. Check that the tag is assigned to one task.

missing_task_identifier.message: Provide task_id or title to complete a task.

addon_unreachable.title: Meitheal addon is unreachable
addon_unreachable.description:
Cannot connect to the Meitheal addon: {error}

Please check:
1. The Meitheal addon is running (Settings → Add-ons → Meitheal)
2. The hostname and port are correct (Settings → Integrations → Meitheal → Configure)
3. The addon container is healthy (`ha addons info local_meitheal`)
